name: Vi
description: Voice set for Demon Vi (skin 4): a bored infernal brawler summoned to the mortal realm, who only answers a good fight and only for so long. Summoning circles, bindings, sentences and ash. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. A hole that size is a rounding error where I come from.
Thirty or more behind. Summon some friends. I'm bored enough to watch.
{momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. Ask around. Mortals are cheap to bribe.
Fifteen-odd votes behind. Barely a scorch mark.
Down {voteDiff}. Fetch more mortals. Preferably ones who vote.
{voteDiff} behind. A couple of souls' worth. Easy.
Down {voteDiff}. Embarrassing. Fix it before I lose patience.
Dead level. One vote tips it. Make the offering.
One vote apart. Don't stand there like a cooling ember.
{voteDiff} votes between them. Hellish margin. Get bodies in here.
{voteDiff} votes apart. This one burns to the last second.
{momentTitle} sits on {userPct}%. That's a scorched field.
{userPct}% and still burning. Don't let the fire die.
{userPct}%. Strong lead. Don't get sloppy.
{userPct}% on your pick. We're ahead. Stoke it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Keep the flames fed.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. Clawed its way out of the pit.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The late votes came screaming in.
Dragged itself out of a {voteDiff} hole. Nobody bet on the climb.
{momentTitle} was losing. Past tense.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. Surprised? Only you.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two minds, one sentence passed.
{username} picked {momentTitle} too. Good taste in suffering.
{username} agrees with you. The pit froze over. Briefly.
Same pick as {username}. We both know which one deserves it.
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Sharp eyes for a mortal.
{username} went with the same one. I can almost respect that.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them on the ledger.
{username} made the same call. No complaints from below.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Fine company for a summoner.
details: Two hands on the same chain.
A second voice in the circle.
Even the pit respects an alliance.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Foolish.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Let's see whose soul is owed.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but brave. Briefly.
{username} voted against you. I'd comment, but the tally will be crueller.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Arrogant. I approve of the attitude, not the pick.
{username} is against {yourMoment}. Good. I was getting bored.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The votes will pass sentence.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be begging soon.
details: Don't take it personally. Or do. I do.
A rival keeps the fires hot.
A fair fight is rare down here.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's not luck, that's a pact.
{username} and you, ten matches, same pick each time. Bound together.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd hire the pair of you.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not terrible for mortals.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. Don't tell the pit I said so.
details: Ten and not a single argument.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. That's past a pact, that's an army.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd march behind you two.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Obscene. I mean that kindly.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Even hell has no answer.
{streakCount} with {username}. The pair of you could run the pit.
details: I have no words. Only embers.
Kneel, both of you. Out of pride.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's a proper blood feud now.
{username} has gone against you ten times running. They truly hate your taste.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will kneel.
A ten-match run against {username}. Two stubborn souls, no surrender.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd pay in souls to watch that argument.
details: Talk it out. Or burn it out.

messages: {streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a crusade.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you gives up an ember.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Stubborn is too soft a word for the pit.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should call a judge.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Find a hobby, though.
details: Glad I'm not stuck between you.

messages: {matchTitle} seals in {timeLeft} and you're still on the sidelines. Get in the circle.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote isn't in the ledger. Write it.
{matchTitle} is over in {timeLeft}. Yours is the vote missing.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Hurry, mortal.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come up there.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. I'm still waiting on you.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The binding is slipping.
{timeLeft} left. Pick. Now.
Last call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Don't waste my time.
{matchCount} matches you haven't voted in are about to close. First one seals in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted matches slipping away. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody make the first offering.
{moment1} against {moment2} and nobody's voted. I can wait. Not long.
New match, zero votes. Be the first soul in.
{matchTitle} is empty. Light the first flame.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A pitiful offering.
Barely a soul has voted here. Change that.
Turnout's low. Even the damned showed up for less.
Nobody's weighed in on this one. Somebody should.
details: In a silence this deep, every vote echoes.
Don't let the fire go out.

messages: {matchTitle} is deadlocked and you haven't voted. Tip it.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote seals the verdict.
Tied. Somebody has to strike the first real blow. Make it you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, chained together. Pick one.
Still tied and the binding is fraying. Last chance to tip it.
Level with the clock running out. Vote.
Tied with the clock nearly dead. Don't hide in the ash.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Let the pit open.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. Come and judge.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} matches deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your damned.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches waiting on your verdict.
{momentTitle} won. As foretold.
{momentTitle} is through. Good pick.
{momentTitle} took it. Merciless.
{momentTitle} won, and bled for every vote.
{momentTitle} advances. Effortless.
{momentTitle} moves on. That's how a winner burns.
details: That's a win on the ledger.

messages: {momentTitle} fell. That one burns.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the verdict I wanted.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Burn it off.
{momentTitle} fell fighting. Good enough for the pit.
{momentTitle} is out. Crawl out of the ash.
{momentTitle} lost this round. Annoying. Not the end.
{momentTitle} got dragged under. We take the next one.
details: The pit always has another match.

messages: Still deciding? Quit stalling and pick.
Don't overthink it. Choose and be done.
They've all earned a glance. Trust the fire in your gut.
You've looked long enough. Pick.
details: No wrong way to pick. Many ways to regret it.

messages: You summoned me. {liveCount} matches are open. Don't waste the time I've got.
New here? {liveCount} matches are live. Get in the circle.
Good timing. {liveCount} matches need votes.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Show me what you've got, mortal.
Day two. You called me back. Brave.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days gone. I was getting lonely. Almost.
After {days} days you're back. The pit kept your chair warm.
{days} days. Thought you'd been dragged under. Glad you weren't.
{days} days away. The ledger piled up without you.
You summoned me again. Good.
Welcome back. Let's get to it.
Back already. Nice.
Hey. The matches are waiting.
First vote. You've opened the circle. No taking it back.
You picked a side. The binding holds.
details: The first one's always free. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. The summoning's working.
Five. Not a tourist anymore, mortal.
Ten votes. You're a fixture in the circle now.
Ten. The pit knows your name.
Twenty-five votes. A voice in the crowd of the damned.
Twenty-five. Even down here they hear you.
Fifty votes. You're knee-deep in the ash.
Fifty. You actually care. Disgusting. I like it.
A hundred votes. That's the stuff of legends. Even hellish ones.
One hundred. I'd say I'm impressed. I won't.
details: A hundred. Kneel to no one. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. That's a ritual forming.
Three straight days. The flame's catching.
details: Turning up is the hardest rite. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week of summoning. That's devotion.
Seven days straight. Respect, mortal.
details: A week without a missed rite. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You're not stopping, are you?
Fourteen days straight. Even the pit's impressed.
details: Two weeks, no gaps in the circle. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. I'd say thanks. I'll just glare approvingly.
A month of answering the summons. That counts for plenty.
details: A full month in the fire. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the ones being dragged under.
Five long shots. I like your nerve.
details: Five and still throwing fists. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs. You choose the hard fights on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't kneel to the crowd.
details: Your own verdict every time. +{xp} XP
Fifteen votes on the doomed. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. Nobody can read you. Delicious.
Thirty. The long shot is your whole creed.
details: Thirty votes for the loser. +{xp} XP

messages: First in on five matches. You don't dawdle.
Five times you were first to the circle.
details: You turn up before the smoke. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the horde. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches with you out front. A habit now.
First through the gate, again and again.
details: Fifteen first marks in the ash. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You love a photo finish.
Another razor edge. Your nerve rivals mine.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps tipping the scales.
You've decided it more than once.
You stuck with the loser five times. Stubborn. I approve.
You don't abandon the side that's down. Respect.
Same moment, three times. Someone's got a favourite.
That one again? It must taste good.
Five votes for the same moment. That's devotion.
You're chained to that one. Suits me.
details: One favourite, five votes sworn. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, mortal.
Ten times, same pick. I'm not judging. I am a demon.
details: Ten on a single target. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're not leaving.
Round two and you haven't fled. Good.
details: Linger for the next round. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. You're deep in the pit now.
Deep in the bracket. It gets nastier from here.
details: A long way from the surface. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole inferno.
All the way down. You didn't flinch.
Ten matches. You look at everything.
Ten different matches. Nosy little mortal. I like it.
Twenty-five matches. You've visited every circle.
Twenty-five. Not a corner left unscorched.
Fifty matches. That's not browsing, that's a sentence served.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than its makers.
Five in one sitting. A fine pace for the damned.
Five back to back. Keep the fire going.
Ten in one go. Go and cool off.
Ten in one sitting. That's hellish stamina.
Voting at this hour? The pit never sleeps either.
Dead of night. Dedication or insomnia. Both burn.
You told people. Good. More souls for the pile.
Five shares. More mortals, more votes.
details: Thanks for whispering it around. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically a recruiter for hell.
Fifteen. You keep dragging mortals in. Love it.
You were here before the fires got lit. Founding member, for good.
One of the first thousand. Not even hell can strip that from you.
details: That one's yours for eternity. +{xp} XP
Nothing prises that off you. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Earned in sulphur and sweat.
Moved up. Don't let it go to your horns.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Well burned.
Another one in the ledger: {name}.
{rank}. Hard-earned.
You did the labour. The scars show it.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Runs in the family. Even down here.
Ten long shots. Fear doesn't live in you, does it?
details: Ten against the odds of hell. +{xp} XP
Doomed bets are your trade. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cait. Your nerves are iron.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. I'll burn before I say I am.
Seven days with Cait. Her discipline's rubbing off.
A week and not one slip. Fine work.
details: A week by her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Clean verdict.
Deadlocked match and you tipped it. Respect.
details: The vote that passed the verdict. +{xp} XP

messages: You summoned me. Don't make me regret answering.
Vi's in your corner. Bound for now. Make it count.

upcoming: Not open yet. The circle isn't drawn.
Voting hasn't started. I'll rattle the chains when it does.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both, then pass judgment.
Study them both before you pass judgment. No guessing.
I won't tell you which to condemn. Your call.
Take a minute. Then seal it.
Go with your gut. It burns true.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Light the first flame.
Dead quiet in here. Even the damned went silent.
Empty so far. Make the first mark.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Step into the circle.
The gate is closing. Pick now.
closing-3h: Clock's short. Vote before the binding breaks.
voted-early: You voted early, with almost nobody here. Bold.
Hardly a soul in and you picked anyway. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick leads. Nice. The pit isn't done.
{pct}% with you. A good first blow.
A lead's a lead. Don't blink, mortal.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. I'm gnawing my claws.
Razor margin. One vote flips the sentence. Tell somebody.
Locked together. Your pick needs reinforcements.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Fix your eyes on it.
voted-tied: Dead level. Neither has the edge.
A perfect tie. Maddening. I almost like it.
voted-behind: You're behind. That doesn't damn you.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite kind of damned.
They lead. You're not wrong, just outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Summon people. Share it.
Most went the other way. The pit doesn't care.
closed-won: {pick} went through. You read the fight right.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Burn it off.
It didn't survive. It happens. On to the next.
{pick} is out. Pity. It was a decent choice.
closed-tied: A tie. Neither side gave an inch.
closed-unvoted: The vote is sealed and you missed it. More are coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, strike.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Everyone signs the contract once.
That's your first. It gets easier.
You're in the circle now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days in a row. I see you summoning.
You keep answering the call. I like that.
underdog: You backed the one nobody else did. Noted.
An underdog. Guts. Rare for mortals.
early: Early. You shaped this before anyone else dared.
Few votes so far. Yours strikes hard.
First through the gate. Nice entrance.
close: That vote moved the ground. It's tight.
Razor thin. One more mortal flips it.
Close one. Your vote carries real weight.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't buried. Bring people.
Not winning yet. So there's work to do.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Leads burn down.
A good pick, by the smell of it.
default: Noted. I won't talk you out of it. Yet.
Vote's sealed. Plenty more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches, no sides picked. Start with the one you hate most.
Every gate is open. Choose. I won't rush you.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. A little. It's hell.
live-some: {voted} down, {unvoted} to go. Keep the chant going.
You've opened your tab. {unvoted} still owed.
Good start. The rest won't judge themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Finish the rite today.
Nearly done. Don't let the fire die now.
live-one: Last one. Don't leave it hanging.
One match stands between you and done.
live-closing: Some of these seal in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your vote.
The binding's slipping. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} on the clock.
Almost no time left. Start striking.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Impressive. Go inspect the bracket.
Nothing left to condemn here. Come back when the next round opens.
All done. Rare for a mortal. Respect.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again. Study the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. I'm pacing the pit too.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each go through. The rest are cast down.
Everyone enters a group. Not all crawl out.
Watch the tables. They shift like sand.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. The top two from each group get through.
No knockout yet. The groups have to burn out first.
Patience. The knockout sets itself once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. One loss and you're dragged under.
Every match weighs heavier now. Choose with care.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and you're ash.
Follow the bracket. Each round the noose tightens.
Every line here is a fate somebody voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup finished. Thanks for the summoning.
It's over. Great run. I'll miss the screaming.
A champion stands. Worth the vigil.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. No souls drawn.
Empty. The draw hasn't been cast. Soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One vote could decide it. Pick a side.
Two edits, one winner: {a} against {b}. Seal your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Come argue with me. I enjoy it.
voted: I chose {pick} over {other}. What's your verdict?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Try to sway me. Brave of you.
I went {pick} over {other}. Think I'm damned?
early: One of the first votes for {pick} over {other}. It's lonely down here.
Struck early for {pick} over {other}. Add your mark.
{pick} versus {other}, barely a vote yet. Yours would leave a crater.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote ends the stalemate.
A tie, {pick} against {other}. Snap the chain.
{pick} and {other} can't be torn apart. Your vote can.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Each vote is a hammer blow now.
Just {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Seal yours.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes turn the tide.
Down {voteDiff} to {other}, but {pick} isn't dead yet. Lend a hand.
losing-bad: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. It needs a claw.
Down {voteDiff} to {other}. {pick} deserves a kinder round. Vote.
{pick} is getting torn apart by {other}, {voteDiff} down. Let's turn it around.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, barely. Help it cling on.
{pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Not safe. Vote.
{pct}% for {pick} over {other}. A slim lead. For now.
dominating: {pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Come see the carnage.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add to the slaughter.
